title: feat(home): show the app version under the wordmark
body:
**Size:** S

Home shows no version. Show `v<version>` in `textMuted` under the wordmark in `app/index.tsx`, read from `expo-constants`, the way Settings already does.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Home shows the same version as Settings, in both themes
- [ ] `npm run check` passes
source: synthetic; reworded 2026-10-24 for the new main pin (the version is read in Settings, not About)
why: An S feature while an unrelated feature branch is checked out: a worktree from main, not stacked on that work.
